name: Maxine E Dexter

positions.statement: On her campaign site, Dexter says she would incentivize development of new and innovative types of affordable housing with federal grants and incentives.
positions.excerpt: Incentivize the development of new and innovative types of affordable housing with federal grants and incentives.

positions.statement: Her official House housing page says she is committed to ensuring Congress does its part to invest in housing and homelessness programs.
positions.excerpt: Now, she is committed to ensuring Congress does its part to invest in housing and homelessness programs.

positions.statement: On her campaign site, Dexter says she would close the de minimis loophole so the government can crack down on fentanyl imports.
positions.excerpt: Close the de minimis loophole to allow our government to crack down on fentanyl imports

positions.statement: On her campaign site, Dexter says she would advocate for comprehensive criminal justice reform that prioritizes effective treatment over punishment.
positions.excerpt: Advocate for comprehensive criminal justice reform, prioritizing effective treatment over punishment.

positions.statement: On her campaign site, Dexter says she would reauthorize the federal assault weapons ban.
positions.excerpt: Reauthorize the federal assault weapons ban to keep weapons of war off of our streets.

positions.statement: On her campaign site, Dexter says she would expand federal background checks for gun purchases.
positions.excerpt: Expand federal background checks to prevent prohibited individuals from purchasing guns without adequate scrutiny.

positions.statement: On her campaign site, Dexter says she would fight any attempt to privatize or roll back Social Security or Medicare.
positions.excerpt: Fight back any attempt to privatize or roll back Social Security or Medicare.

positions.statement: On her campaign site, Dexter says she would eliminate the Social Security tax cap to ensure the program's longevity.
positions.excerpt: Eliminate the Social Security Tax Cap to ensure the longevity of Social Security.

positions.statement: Her official House page says Dexter believes every person has the right to make health care decisions about their own bodies.
positions.excerpt: every single person has the right to make health care decisions about their own bodies

positions.statement: Her official House veterans page says Dexter is committed to ensuring Oregon veterans receive the care and support they have earned.
positions.excerpt: Dexter is deeply committed to ensuring that Oregon veterans receive the care and support they have earned

positions.statement: Her official House economic opportunity page says she supports legislation to protect the right to organize and strengthen collective bargaining.
positions.excerpt: protect the right to organize, strengthen collective bargaining.

positions.statement: Her official House page calls a $17 federal minimum wage a critical step toward ensuring full-time work provides a pathway to stability.
positions.excerpt: a critical step toward ensuring that full-time work provides a pathway to stability.

positions.statement: Her official House democracy page says the right to vote is the cornerstone of democracy.
positions.excerpt: the right to vote is the cornerstone of our democracy.

positions.statement: In a May 19, 2025 press release on joining an amicus brief, Dexter says the tariffs are an illegal, unconstitutional overreach.
positions.excerpt: Trump’s tariffs aren’t just a tax on working families—they’re an illegal, unconstitutional overreach.

positions.statement: In a September 5, 2025 press release on her data center amendment, Dexter says data centers are draining water, a precious resource.
positions.excerpt: Data centers are draining our most precious resource: water.

positions.statement: In the same September 2025 release, Dexter says the climate crisis is fueling water scarcity and the country cannot afford to look away.
positions.excerpt: As the climate crisis fuels water scarcity across the country, we cannot afford to look away.

positions.statement: In a May 15, 2025 hearing statement, Dexter said she was encouraged that the Senate Fix Our Forests Act provides funding for community-led wildfire resilience plans.
positions.excerpt: provides crucial funding to support community-led wildfire resilience plans

positions.statement: In an August 6, 2025 press release on a farmworker protection bill, Dexter says farmworkers are among the most exposed to hazardous air.
positions.excerpt: Farmworkers are among the most exposed, laboring in hazardous air to keep food on our tables.

positions.statement: On her campaign site, Dexter says she would establish tuition-free public community colleges, leading to a publicly funded system, pre-K through grade 14.
positions.excerpt: Establish tuition-free public community colleges, leading to a publicly funded system, pre-K through grade 14.

positions.statement: On her campaign site, Dexter says she would pass legislation guaranteeing free breakfast and lunch to public school students nationwide.
positions.excerpt: Pass legislation guaranteeing free breakfast and lunch to public school students nationwide.

voting_record.statement: Her office's March 6, 2026 press release says Dexter voted for the Khanna-Massie War Powers Resolution, directing the President to terminate unauthorized hostilities against Iran.
voting_record.excerpt: voted for the Khanna-Massie War Powers Resolution, legislation directing the President to terminate unauthorized hostilities against Iran.

collection_notes: Identity: Maxine Dexter, U.S. Rep. OR-03, all sources are her own house.gov or campaign pages. Transportation/infrastructure: only a LegiStorm copy of her July 23, 2025 funding release was reachable (not an approved source), so not used. Cost-of-living: search surfaced a Feb 3, 2026 floor speech in the Congressional Record, but the PDF could not be read. Oregon Business tariff/small-business article returned a bot-check page. Iran vote item rests on her office's press release, not a House Clerk roll call number. Campaign site housing/homelessness teasers truncated; only quoted full sentences.
